fields.description: Set automatically from the reference document's own fund (Cashbook Payment/Petty Cash Replenishment) -- defaults to Fund A for fee-side entries (Invoice/Receipt), which this app doesn't otherwise fund-tag. Used to keep SDC's GL access scoped to Fund B, same as every other procurement doctype.

fields.description: Set only by reverse_journal_entry() -- points to the compensating entry that reversed this one, if any.
